method: Read-only 3 mother worlds x 2 fixed seeds. Exact production geometry/body/sight/throw/sound path functions; patrol model uses production speed/turn/pause contracts, sampled500ms over60s. 16px observer lattice, search<=48px, approach physical<=192px, shoulder radius90%,16 throw directions. A positive candidate proves geometry at an unalerted sample, not actual arrival without escalation, sustained safe observation, diversion success, search-noise safety or profitable extraction. Null is bounded negative, never proof that all continuous-time/player routes fail. Content ids used only for posthoc diagnosis, never supplied to playing agents.
